gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a tiny newsroom gardener updating a glowing retro README terminal while a star-chart plant climbs upward behind her. Use the star history as a friendly garden-growth metaphor, with small flowers and GitHub-like stars rather than corporate analytics.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the cute pollinations.ai bee mascot wearing a tiny editor visor, updating a retro CRT terminal labeled 'README' while a lime green (#ecf874) star-chart vine grows gently upward beside it, dotted with warm cream flowers and little pixel stars.
